ELECTION TO INCLUDE IN GROSS INCOME IN THE YEAR OF TRANSFER
OF PROPERTY PURSUANT TO SECTION 83(b) OF THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE

The undersigned taxpayer hereby elects, pursuant to Section 83(b) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended, and Treasury Regulations Section 1.83-2 promulgated thereunder, to include in gross income for the taxpayer's current taxable year the excess, if any, of the fair market value of the property described below at the time of transfer over the amount paid for such property.

1. Name, address, and taxpayer identification number of the taxpayer making this election:

Name: Elena Marie Vasquez
Address: 2210 Ridgemont Lane, Austin, Texas 78703
Taxpayer identification number: on file with the Company

The taxpayer's spouse is not making this election.

2. Description of the property with respect to which the election is being made:

1,500,000 shares of common stock, par value $0.00001 per share, of Sentinel Grid Technologies, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the "Company").

3. Date on which the property was transferred and the taxable year for which the election is being made:

The property was transferred on July 8, 2026. The election is being made for the taxpayer's taxable year ending December 31, 2026.

4. Nature of the restrictions to which the property is subject:

The shares are subject to a repurchase option in favor of the Company at the original purchase price, which option lapses as to 1/48th of the shares on each monthly anniversary of June 1, 2026, subject to the taxpayer's continuous service to the Company. The shares are also subject to transfer restrictions and a right of first refusal in favor of the Company, in each case as set forth in the Restricted Stock Purchase Agreement between the taxpayer and the Company dated July 8, 2026.

5. Fair market value of the property at the time of transfer:

The fair market value at the time of transfer, determined without regard to any restriction other than a restriction which by its terms will never lapse, is $0.00001 per share, or $15.00 in the aggregate.

6. Amount paid for the property:

The taxpayer paid $0.00001 per share, or $15.00 in the aggregate, for the property.

7. Amount to include in gross income:

The amount to include in gross income is $0.00.

The undersigned has submitted a copy of this election to the Company. The undersigned understands that this election must be filed with the Internal Revenue Service office with which the taxpayer files the taxpayer's federal income tax return no later than 30 days after the date of transfer of the property, and that this election may not be revoked without the consent of the Commissioner of Internal Revenue.

Dated: July 15, 2026

/s/ Elena Marie Vasquez
Elena Marie Vasquez, Taxpayer
